name: fly-cable-incline
title: Fly: Cable (Incline)
primer: This exercise is an alternative to the Butterfly or Pec Deck. It defines the muscles of the chest.
steps: Place an incline bench set at a 45 degree angle between two cable towers, and lie on it with your feet firmly on the ground.
Grasp a pulley in each hand with your palms facing up.
With a slight bend in your elbows, squeeze your chest and pull the cables in an arc so they meet together in the middle of your chest.
Hold for a moment and then slowly lower your hands back to the starting position along the same arc.
